Read and filter data from the CAPES Catalog of Theses and Dissertations

Source: R/capes.R
read_capes_data.Rd

This function combines data from multiple Parquet files and applies optional filters, including text-based searches.

Usage

read_capes_data(files, filters = list())

ler_dados_capes(files, filters = list())

Arguments

files

A vector or list of paths to Parquet files.

filters

A named list of filters. Values for the text columns `titulo` and `resumo` (or `title`/`abstract`) are matched as case-insensitive substrings, and a vector of terms keeps the rows containing any of them (e.g., `list(titulo = c("varicela", "catapora"))`); all other columns are matched exactly (e.g., `list(ano_base = 1987, uf = "SP", titulo = "educação")`).

Value

A `data.frame` containing the combined and filtered data.

Columns

The yearly files have one row per thesis or dissertation and the columns below (names in Portuguese, as in the CAPES source):

ano_base

Reference year.

ies

Higher education institution.

area

Evaluation area (*área de avaliação*).

nome_programa

Graduate program.

tipo

Type of work (e.g. master's dissertation, doctoral thesis).

titulo, resumo

Title and abstract.

idioma

Language of the work.

autoria, orientacao

Author and advisor.

regiao, uf

Region and state of the institution.

grande_area, cd_grande_area

Broad knowledge area (*grande área de conhecimento*): name and CAPES code.

area_conhecimento, cd_area_conhecimento

Knowledge area: name and code.

subarea, cd_subarea

Knowledge subarea: name and code (2013 onwards).

especialidade, cd_especialidade

Specialty: name and code (2013 onwards).

area_concentracao

Concentration area of the program (2013 onwards).

The codes are stored as text. CAPES does not publish subarea, specialty and concentration area for 1987-2012, so those columns are `NA` in these years.

Examples

# \donttest{
# Download data for the years 1987 and 1990
capes_files <- download_capes_data(c(1987, 1990))
#> File already exists: /var/folders/j9/7g_srh2x0d71c5q0pbj5mxh40000gn/T//RtmpsIBZXJ/capes_1987.parquet
#> File already exists: /var/folders/j9/7g_srh2x0d71c5q0pbj5mxh40000gn/T//RtmpsIBZXJ/capes_1990.parquet
# Combine all selected data
combined_data <- read_capes_data(capes_files)
# }
